categories.main_business_segments: Qinhuangdao Tianqin Equipment Manufacturing Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of specialized protective devices and equipment components based on polymer materials, resin-based composites, and metal materials. Its main products include specialized protective devices for defense equipment, ammunition storage and transportation protection, and various equipment parts. The company also provides technical services and some civilian protective products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced technologies such as polymer material modification, finite element analysis, mold flow analysis, and injection molding. It has proprietary high-performance engineering plastics and resin-based composite materials with excellent impact resistance, heat resistance, and cold resistance. Production involves both in-house manufacturing and outsourced processing for non-core components, with strict quality control and compliance with national defense standards.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are defense equipment manufacturers, including ammunition assembly plants and defense equipment exporters, as well as final military users across army, navy, air force, and rocket forces. The company also serves civilian markets with customized protective products. Major customers include subsidiaries of China North Industries Group Corporation (China Ordnance Group) and China Ordnance Equipment Group Corporation.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within China, with significant sales concentrated in Northeast China, Northwest China, Southwest China, East China, Central China, South China, and North China regions. It also engages in export activities through defense equipment foreign trade channels.
categories.supply_chain_position: Qinhuangdao Tianqin Equipment Manufacturing operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the defense equipment supply chain, focusing on specialized protective devices and equipment components that are integrated into larger defense systems by original equipment manufacturers (OEMs). It also extends upstream by developing proprietary polymer materials through its subsidiaries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes strategic, forward-looking R&D in new materials, intelligent and information-based defense equipment protection, and integrated storage-transport-launch devices. It pursues innovation through independent research and development, industry-academia collaboration, and expanding its intellectual property portfolio. Key R&D projects include missile protective boxes, integrated missile launch tubes, large guided bomb packaging, and permanent antistatic materials.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of proprietary specialized protective devices and equipment components to defense manufacturers and final users. Additional income comes from technical development contracts and services. The company also earns investment income from financial assets and government subsidies related to R&D and production.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading specialized protective device and equipment component supplier within China's defense industry, recognized as a national-level specialized and innovative 'Little Giant' enterprise. It holds multiple industry certifications and has a strong reputation among major defense groups. Competitors include other specialized component manufacturers within the defense supply chain, but the company benefits from early entry, strong R&D capabilities, and close ties with key defense OEMs.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 230.54 million, a 49.14% increase from 2023, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 41.68 million, up 29.49%. Total assets reached about RMB 1.04 billion, with net assets of RMB 902.95 million. The company has shown steady growth in revenue and profitability, supported by increased sales and ongoing investment in R&D and production capacity.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through proprietary high-performance materials with superior mechanical and environmental resistance, integrated design and manufacturing capabilities, and compliance with stringent defense standards. Its products ensure the safety and reliability of defense equipment under extreme conditions, offering customers enhanced durability, impact resistance, and multi-functional protective solutions. Long-term partnerships with major defense OEMs and a comprehensive quality management system further strengthen its competitive advantage.
